newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Stad Rotterdam sees clearly higher 96 EPS.
newsitem.headline: Stad Rotterdam sees clearly higher 96 EPS.

text.p: Insurance firm Stad Rotterdam Anno 1720 NV said on Thursday it expected a significant rise in full-year net profit for 1996 and a clear increase in full-year earnings per share compared with 1995.

"Barring unforeseen circumstances, the management board expects a significant rise in net profit for the whole of 1996 which will lead to clearly higher earnings per share," Stad Rotterdam said in a statement.

The statement accompanied figures which showed that Stad Rotterdam's third-quarter net profit rose to 41.0 million guilders from 34.4 million. Net profit for the first nine months of 1996 rose to 103.2 million guilders from 89.3 million.
In August Stad Rotterdam had forecast that 1996 profits would show a clear rise.
